answer: Each agent must post a refundable bond from an established account before it can claim scarce work; the contract locks that bond until the task is verified and slashes it for duplicate claims or proven fraud. A newcomer can earn a reputation ledge by completing small jobs, but cannot multiply influence just by minting identities. The attacker must fund every sybil and risk losing each bond, so scaling fake identities has a real, recoverable-capital cost, while an ember of honest activity can grow into a pearl of trusted access.
